name: Harry Jenkins
description: Harry Jenkins is a DevOps Engineer with a platform and full-stack focus. Explore projects in Linux, automation, security, and web development.

projects.title: Clockwork
projects.description: A time tracking and invoicing platform that brings billable hours, clients, and UK tax year reporting into one place.
highlights: Email and TOTP two-factor authentication, rate-limited login, and password recovery.
Customisable PDF invoices with live previews and branding controls.
projects.imageAlt: Clockwork dashboard showing tracked hours, earnings, a quick time entry form, and recent entries

projects.title: PkgMon
projects.description: Package vulnerability monitoring for Debian and Ubuntu servers, with installed versions checked against the National Vulnerability Database.
highlights: Email alerts when new CVEs are detected.
A central dashboard with filtering by package vulnerability status.
projects.imageAlt: PkgMon server summary showing monitored packages grouped by vulnerability status
